title: Validity of parity block values
statement: Let $n,r,g$ be natural numbers, let $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$, and define the block assignment by taking its $j$th entry to be $x_{gr+j}$ when $gr+j<n$ and $1$ otherwise. Every entry whose index satisfies $n\le gr+j$ is $1$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a sign vector of length $n$
